issues.where: the volcanic floor across the foreground and midground
issues.what: the dark, fractured basalt rock, loose rubble, and lower-left rocky ridge of -a are replaced by a smooth tan-brown surface with artificial swirling contour marks and a single clean diagonal crack
issues.fix: replace the smooth brown ground with rough, dark charcoal basalt crust, loose volcanic rubble, a dark out-of-focus rock ridge in the lower left, and an organic network of glowing lava fissures

issues.where: the upper-right background and midground terrain
issues.what: the dramatic dark volcanic cliff and craggy slope behind the creatures are missing, leaving an empty flat peach-brown fog gradient
issues.fix: restore the dark craggy cliff face on the upper right and the stepped volcanic ridges behind the creatures, separated by layered smoke rather than uniform fog

issues.where: the background lava cascade on the left and the lava fissure under the feeding creature
issues.what: the lava looks like flat, unshaded orange-yellow blobs and a sharp-edged line with no white-hot cores, dark cooling crust, bloom, rising steam, or warm bounce light on the surrounding rock
issues.fix: give the lava white-hot incandescent cores, broken dark crust, soft bloom, rising fume around the feeding pool, and strong warm uplight on the nearby ground and creatures

issues.where: the lava cascade pouring from the cave mouth down to the valley floor
issues.what: the flow reads as flat orange-yellow paint and thin uniform spiderweb lines without white-hot incandescence, chunky cooling crust, bloom, or strong warm bounce light on the flanking rock
issues.fix: push the lava cores to white-hot with soft bloom, break the flow into irregular braided molten channels with dark crusted edges, and cast warm orange light onto the adjacent rock faces

issues.where: the foreground plane along the bottom of the frame
issues.what: the rough, out-of-focus dark basalt floor with a diagonal glowing fissure is replaced by a flat, glassy surface with blurry orange reflections and a ruler-straight horizon edge
issues.fix: replace the flat reflective foreground with uneven, out-of-focus dark volcanic rock rising slightly on the left and cut by a natural glowing lava crack

issues.where: the cave mouth, ceiling arch, and overall contrast
issues.what: the cave interior is a lifted, flat grey-black void behind blocky, faceted arch walls and a straight horizontal lip, with washed-out contrast across the cliffs
issues.fix: deepen the shadow blacks inside the cave and cliffs, sculpt organic stratified basalt ribs on the arch, break up the straight cave lip, and let the molten lip cast a softer, richer glow across the rough ceiling

issues.where: atmosphere, haze, and overall colour contrast
issues.what: the scene is washed out with flat peach-brown midtones and weak blacks instead of deep charcoal shadows, wispy drifting volcanic smoke, and dramatic ember glow
issues.fix: deepen the darks to charcoal, reduce the uniform brown fog, and add layered, wispy volcanic fume backlit by the lava

issues.where: the foreground and background creatures' skin, feet, and feeding tendrils
issues.what: the hides look smooth and CG with dangling shred artifacts under the foreground torso, flat triangular and spade-like feet, untextured ribbon-like tendrils, and weak rim and under-lighting from the lava
issues.fix: add rough fibrous-rocky hide detail and bony joint definition, remove the hanging torso shreds, sculpt organic flared feet and finely textured tendrils, and add crisp warm rim and under-lighting from the lava

issues.where: the ground around the feeding tendrils and lower-right lava fissures in the full-size crops
issues.what: at delivery size the ground shows smooth low-frequency bumps and dark procedural swirl striations with almost no rocky grit, molten pooling, or steam around the tendril tips
issues.fix: replace the swirled procedural pattern with sharp basalt fracture detail, small dark rubble, a crusted molten pool around the tendril tips, and wisps of lit steam

issues.where: the rocky slope beside the lava and the left talus slope in the full-size crops
issues.what: the fine volcanic scree, sharp basalt ledges, and hot specular lava reflections of -a are replaced by muddy, low-contrast grey-brown ground scattered with soft, oversized blobby boulders
issues.fix: sharpen the rock micro-detail into crisp dark basalt ledges and fine loose scree, reduce the blobby boulders, and add tighter warm specular highlights where lava light grazes the rock

issues.where: the smoke plume rising on the lower right and the two small creatures at the base
issues.what: the fume reads as a single soft pink-grey airbrushed cloud, and the creatures sit against a dim flat slope with overly bright pale tendrils instead of being backlit in warm luminous haze by a bright lava pool
issues.fix: break the smoke into wispy, brightly underlit volcanic fume rising from a white-hot pooling base, and silhouette the two creatures in that warm backlight and haze
